Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Borrower account in the lending ledger tracking principal, 2% monthly interest, and collection status.

disbursementDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of initial loan disbursement

dueDayOfMonth.description: Day of the month (1-31) when monthly interest is due

extraPrincipalAdded.description: Cumulative principal added via loan top-ups

principalRepaid.description: Cumulative principal repaid via partial payments and closures

currentActivePrincipal.description: Calculated active principal: initial + top-ups - repaid

monthlyInterestDue.description: Calculated monthly interest due: currentActivePrincipal * rate / 100

lastPaymentDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the most recent payment

lastInterestPaidMonth.description: Year-month YYYY-MM covered by the latest interest or closure payment

followUpNotes.description: Field collection remarks and follow-up notes

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

LoanTransaction.title: LoanTransaction
LoanTransaction.description: Immutable chronological audit trail entry linked to a Customer.

customerId.description: Firestore document ID of the linked Customer

transactionDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the transaction

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Lender's borrower accounts scoped by userId

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Immutable financial ledger transactions scoped by userId
